tutorial.greeting: <#a8dcff>Lotte Laterne:</#a8dcff> <#f1e2c2>Welcome to Kronstadt, {name}! Over there – no, the other over there – is where it all begins.
tutorial.step.welcome.hint: <#a8dcff>Lotte Laterne:</#a8dcff> <#f1e2c2>Let me show you around. The bar at the top always tells you what's next.
tutorial.step.plot.hint: <#a8dcff>Lotte Laterne:</#a8dcff> <#f1e2c2>A home first! Your first plot is free: <click:run_command:/gs><hover:show_text:'Open the land register'><#ffcf4a>[Land register]</#ffcf4a></hover></click>
tutorial.step.farm.hint: <#a8dcff>Lotte Laterne:</#a8dcff> <#f1e2c2>Building materials come from the farm world. Waldemar at the portal square takes you there: <click:run_command:/farmwelt><hover:show_text:'To the farm world'><#ffcf4a>[Farm world]</#ffcf4a></hover></click>
tutorial.step.sell.hint: <#a8dcff>Lotte Laterne:</#a8dcff> <#f1e2c2>Fritz at the market buys ores, wood and crops. Sell him something: <click:run_command:/kraemer><hover:show_text:'Open the grocer'><#ffcf4a>[Grocer]</#ffcf4a></hover></click>
tutorial.step.job.hint: <#a8dcff>Lotte Laterne:</#a8dcff> <#f1e2c2>A job earns you crowns on the side. Henni hands out the shifts: <click:run_command:/jobs><hover:show_text:'Open the job board'><#ffcf4a>[Job board]</#ffcf4a></hover></click>
tutorial.step.done.hint: <#a8dcff>Lotte Laterne:</#a8dcff> <#f1e2c2>You know your way around now. Almost as well as I do!
tutorial.done.title: <#ffcf4a>Welcome, citizen!
tutorial.done.subtitle: <#f1e2c2>+{amount} crowns
tutorial.done.repeat: <#4ac85e>Tutorial completed. You already got the bonus once.
tutorial.skipped: <#f1e2c2>Tutorial skipped. Restart it anytime with <click:run_command:/tutorial neu><#ffcf4a>/tutorial neu</#ffcf4a></click>.
